verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec for this product. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI path returning 404. The available artifacts do not qualify: llms.txt and markdown docs are prose documentation, the MPP and ACP specifications are published as prose or markdown protocol specs, and the skills index.json lists agent skills rather than describing the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
